"""Bayesian 2PL+gamma IRT fitting for contamination calibration.

import argparse
import sys
import warnings
from pathlib import Path

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore", category=FutureWarning)


def load_data(data_dir, benchmark):
    data_dir = Path(data_dir)
    resp_path = data_dir / f"response_matrix_{benchmark}.csv"
    if not resp_path.exists():
        sys.exit(f"ERROR: {resp_path} not found")

    resp_df = pd.read_csv(resp_path)
    respondent_ids = resp_df["respondent"].values
    item_cols = [c for c in resp_df.columns if c != "respondent"]
    X = resp_df[item_cols].values.astype(np.float64)

    exp_path = data_dir / "exposure_scores.csv"
    if not exp_path.exists():
        sys.exit(f"ERROR: {exp_path} not found")
    exp_df = pd.read_csv(exp_path)
    exp_map = dict(zip(exp_df["respondent"], exp_df["exposure"]))
    exposure = np.array([exp_map[r] for r in respondent_ids])

    return X, respondent_ids, item_cols, exposure


def fit_2pl_gamma(X, exposure, method="advi", draws=1000, max_items=None, random_seed=42):
    import pymc as pm

    J, I_total = X.shape
    rng = np.random.RandomState(random_seed)

    if max_items and max_items < I_total:
        idx = np.sort(rng.choice(I_total, max_items, replace=False))
        X = X[:, idx]
        I = max_items
    else:
        idx = None
        I = I_total

    print(f"Fitting 2PL+γ: {J} respondents × {I} items, method={method}")

    with pm.Model() as model:
        theta = pm.Normal("theta", mu=0, sigma=1, shape=J)
        log_a = pm.Normal("log_a", mu=0, sigma=0.5, shape=I)
        a = pm.Deterministic("a", pm.math.exp(log_a))
        b = pm.Normal("b", mu=0, sigma=2, shape=I)
        gamma = pm.Normal("gamma", mu=0, sigma=1, shape=I)

        logit_p = a[None, :] * (theta[:, None] - b[None, :]) + gamma[None, :] * exposure[:, None]
        pm.Bernoulli("obs", logit_p=logit_p, observed=X)

        if method == "advi":
            approx = pm.fit(n=20000, method="advi", random_seed=random_seed,
                            progressbar=True)

                              random_seed=random_seed, progressbar=True)

    theta_sd = theta_post.std(axis=(0, 1))

    gamma_mean = gamma_post.mean(axis=(0, 1))
    gamma_sd = gamma_post.std(axis=(0, 1))

    a_post = trace.posterior["a"].values
    b_post = trace.posterior["b"].values
    a_mean = a_post.mean(axis=(0, 1))
    b_mean = b_post.mean(axis=(0, 1))

    print(f"\n--- Theta (ability) ---")

        print(f"  {rid}: θ={theta_mean[j]:.3f} ± {theta_sd[j]:.3f}  (exposure={exposure[j]:.2f})")

    print(f"\n--- Gamma (contamination effect) summary ---")
    print(f"  mean(γ) = {gamma_mean.mean():.4f} ± {gamma_mean.std():.4f}")
    print(f"  median(γ) = {np.median(gamma_mean):.4f}")
    pct_pos = (gamma_mean > 0).mean() * 100
    print(f"  % items with γ > 0: {pct_pos:.1f}%")

    return dict(theta_mean=theta_mean, theta_sd=theta_sd,
                a_mean=a_mean, b_mean=b_mean,
                gamma_mean=gamma_mean, gamma_sd=gamma_sd)

    parser.add_argument("--benchmark", required=True, choices=["mmlu", "arc"])
    parser.add_argument("--data-dir", default=None)
    parser.add_argument("--max-items", type=int, default=None)
